title: Take an Interview — Online Shopping Habits
description: インタビュー形式。4 つの質問に各 45 秒で回答します（準備時間なし）

tasks.label: Take an Interview
tasks.prompt: Thank you for joining the study. Today, I’d like to ask you some questions about your online shopping habits. First, before you buy something online, is it important to compare prices on different websites? Why or why not?
tasks.material:
An interviewer will ask you questions. Answer the questions and be sure to say as much as you can in the time allowed.
No time for preparation will be provided.
You have volunteered for a research study about online shopping habits. You will have a short online interview with a researcher. The researcher will ask you some questions. Please answer the interviewer’s questions.

tasks.label: Take an Interview
tasks.prompt: I see. Now imagine that you want to buy a new pair of shoes. You can order them online and wait a few days for delivery, or you can go to a local store and get them right away, but they cost a little more. Which option would you choose, and why?

tasks.label: Take an Interview
tasks.prompt: Interesting. Some people worry about problems with online shopping, such as late deliveries or damaged items. What do you think are one or two good ways that companies could make online shopping safer or more reliable? Please give reasons for your answer.

tasks.label: Take an Interview
tasks.prompt: Good points. Lastly, looking to the future, some experts think that most shopping will happen online and many physical stores will close. How do you think this change might affect cities in positive ways and negative ways? Please give one example of each.

title: Take an Interview — Spending and Saving Money
description: インタビュー形式。4 つの質問に各 45 秒で回答します（準備時間なし）

tasks.label: Take an Interview
tasks.prompt: Thank you for joining the study. Today, I’d like to ask you some questions about spending and saving money. First, when you receive money, for example from a job or from your family, how do you usually use it? Please describe what you spend it on and how you feel about your habits.
tasks.material:
An interviewer will ask you questions. Answer the questions and be sure to say as much as you can in the time allowed.
No time for preparation will be provided.
You have volunteered for a research study about how people spend and save money. You will have a short online interview with a researcher. The researcher will ask you some questions. Please answer the interviewer’s questions.

tasks.label: Take an Interview
tasks.prompt: I see. Now imagine that you receive a bonus of 200 dollars. You can either spend it on something you really want right now, or save it for a future goal, such as travel or education. Which would you choose, and why?

tasks.label: Take an Interview
tasks.prompt: Interesting. Some people find it hard to control their spending, especially with online shopping and mobile payments. What are one or two things schools or families could do to help young people develop better money habits? Please give reasons for your answer.

tasks.label: Take an Interview
tasks.prompt: Good points. Lastly, in the future, more payments may be completely digital, and people might hardly ever use cash. How do you think this change might affect people’s spending habits in positive ways and negative ways? Please give one example of each.

tasks.label: Take an Interview

tasks.label: Take an Interview

tasks.prompt: Good points. Lastly, looking to the future, some experts think social media will become even more important in everyday life. How do you think this might affect local communities in positive ways and negative ways? Please give one example of each.
